description: Returns the compliance dates of OSHA's 2024 Hazard Communication Standard update (29 CFR 1910.1200) as extended by 91 FR 1695 (January 15, 2026): for chemical manufacturers/importers/distributors and for employers, for substances and for mixtures, with days remaining. Notes that OSHA State Plans may set different dates. Read-only, free.
name: hazcom_2024_deadlines
title: OSHA HazCom 2024 compliance dates
